basics.name: Rajarshi Sen
basics.description: I build systems that scale and am learning how to make them intelligent. With several years of experience engineering reliable backend services in production, I’m expanding into machine learning and AI through graduate study and hands‑on projects. I’m driven by clean design, practical impact, and continuous learning. When I’m not coding, you’ll usually find me behind a camera, chasing light, landscapes, and interesting moments.

highlights: Built and optimized the employee data synchronization pipeline, for seamless on boarding and regular data aggregation, from HRIS, ATS & OAuth systems providers.
Implemented attribute-based access control (ABAC) to enhance data privacy and ensure secure and scalable authorization at user and role levels.
Built user-management and role & user level access control configuration UI, in Clojurescript, and ReactJs.
As part of the services team: Developed a market research module for BloombergQuint (client), a leading financial news platform, which was later acquired by NDTV India.
As a part of the platform team, we built all backend services in Clojure and the UI in Typescript and ReactJs. I worked on and managed multiple microservices, like:
Bold: CMS, rich text news editor, content management system for digital news publishers
Sketches: public content delivery API & with dynamic caching

I handled multiple data migrations to onboard large customers, optimizing processes to transfer terabytes of sensitive data efficiently, and resolving bottlenecks to streamline read-write latencies in our existing systems.
Contributed to rebuilding 'Bold' the CMS platform (news publishing editor) frontend, using Typescript, ReactJs, and NodeJs.
Developed a self-scaling, bulk image import service using AWS Lambda, for on-ground photo journalists.

Led a team to design and implement our in-house Authentication service from scratch, along with a custom SSO implementation, for multi-domain customers. Using NodeJs, JWT, OAuth, PostgreSQL and a Redis Cache. Eventually serving a billion authentications and auth-verifications per month.
Recognized as the youngest engineer trusted with on-call duties & commended for mitigating critical production issues.
Earned early leadership opportunities as the youngest team lead, receiving appreciation for guiding and supporting peers.

projects.name: Orb - Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration Framework
projects.summary: Collaborated on a Python framework where multiple LLM agents collaborate over an async message bus to solve complex tasks. Designed configurable agent topologies (like triad, research-&-build, dual-review) defined via YAML, with dynamic model selection across local and cloud tiers. Includes a TUI, real-time WebSocket dashboard, and a CLI daemon mode.

projects.name: Gnoma - Autonomous Anti-Aging Intervention Discovery via RL
projects.summary: Built a pipeline combining single-cell transcriptomics (61M+ cells), a scVI variational autoencoder, and a hybrid world model (37 causal rules + neural transition model trained on 310k Perturb-seq CRISPR screens) to discover anti-aging interventions. A safety-constrained PPO agent with action masking over 105 interventions independently rediscovered 10/20 top candidates validated in published aging literature, with 102% reward improvement over baseline and zero safety violations.

projects.name: Build a C Compiler
projects.summary: Implementing lexical analysis, parsing, semantic checks, and code generation in Python with modular, testable components.

projects.name: Heuristic Search Algorithm for CRISPR guide RNA Safety Analysis
projects.summary: Implementing a heuristic search algorithm (A*) in Python to predict and rank potential CRISPR-Cas9 off-target sites in genes by calculating Hamming distance, addressing a key safety challenge for therapeutic gene editing.

projects.name: CRISPR-Cas9 Off-target Prediction using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Developed a machine learning model in Python to predict CRISPR-Cas9 off-target effects, achieving 85% accuracy by analyzing genomic sequences and features, contributing to safer gene editing applications.
